description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: HashRing.cs's GetNode picks a node with a modulo of key.GetHashCode() - removing or adding any node reshuffles almost every key (and string.GetHashCode() isn't even stable across process runs in modern .NET, making it worse). Implement a real consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes: the constructor takes (IEnumerable<string> nodes, int replicas) and places `replicas` virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via System.Security.Cryptography.MD5 over $"{node}:{i}" for each virtual point. GetNode(string key) hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). AddNode(string node) and RemoveNode(string node) update the ring in place.
name: add_csharp_consistent_hash_ring
